title: 2500th post: A-Z of Favorite Posts
content: This is the 2500th post on GurneyJourney. My goal with the blog is simply to have some fun and learn something new every day.To mark the occasion, here's an A-Z list of some favorite posts from the last five and a half years since I started the blog.Asymmetrical MakeupBehind the Scenes at G.J.Color Zones of the FaceDo Artists See Differently?EyetrackingFoliage SeriesGamut MaskingHappy Old-Time PhotosIn-Flight PortraitJoy in the FarmyardKinstler DemoLight and FormManhandled by ApesNephroid CausticsOrigami MysteryPhotography as ReferenceQuick DrawRotating EyeballsSmiling PresidentsTwo-Streams HypothesisUnmade BedsVignetting SeriesWindmill PrincipleX-Ray Technique Reveals Dino ColorsYurmby Wheel and other Color WheelsZoo Sketching of GorillasThanks for joining me on the journey. There's a lot more to come.
